pointer_note: This file records the PR52 source-integration moment and is a SOURCE LINEAGE pointer, not the runtime pointer. For the active business runtime use docs/canonical-baseline/CURRENT_HK_RUNTIME.json. On 2026-09-15 the recorded source_commit was moved from the last code commit of PR52 to the PR head itself, because only a PR head is resolvable by the controlled TEST_PR channel; see the canonicalization block. The application tree and its fingerprint are unchanged and were re-derived rather than copied.

runtime_status_20260913.note: Written 2026-09-13. Does not rewrite the historical fields above.

canonicalization.reason: The controlled TEST_PR channel resolves a Request's pr_number to refs/pull/<n>/head and nothing else. The previously recorded source_commit is an intermediate commit of the same branch and is no PR's head, so no signed TEST_PR could ever bind to it and the readiness TEST_PR gate could never pass however many times the round was repeated.
canonicalization.re_derived_not_copied: application_git_tree, source_tree_sha256 and the file count were recomputed from the object store at the PR head rather than copied forward. They equal the previously recorded values because the application tree is byte-identical between the two commits: same 1323 paths, same content for every path.
canonicalization.historical_records_rationale: Those files record the DEPTH48 source-integration moment and the packaging input that produced an already-built parent. Rewriting them would falsify evidence rather than correct a pointer.

release_candidate_note: Added 2026-09-16 by CC V1-08 candidate admission (#103); reconciled the same day with a fresh TEST_PR. Every value here is derived from an artifact that already existed: the signed TEST_PR Evidence supplied artifact_digest and test_result_identity, the staged builder supplied build_definition, the live runtime supplied the rollback target, and the live deploy contract supplied required_services. Nothing here is an approval and nothing here authorises a deployment.
artifact_package_note: Rewritten 2026-09-16 by B4-B1.5; it previously recorded NOT_PROVEN, which was the truth then. durability is PROVEN because it is the truth now: the fresh bounded TEST_PR go-boss-test-pr-52-0342850d8822 was built by test-pr-v3, which seals the image into the fixed store and reports the package content address in its own signed Evidence (package_sha256 e70238c7..., 115588608 bytes, image identity role root_descriptor). The authority chain is signed TEST_PR Evidence -> artifact image -> artifact package; a file merely existing in the host store is not the proof. The v2 result stays in the evidence repository as history, and remains the explanation of why the earlier artifact was never deliverable: it reported built_image_id and then removed the image in its finally block, so no copy of those bytes existed anywhere.

release_candidate_reconciliation.reason: A second fresh bounded TEST_PR was run against this exact candidate through the formal channel (Request PR chenzhenxi1-sudo/go-control-tasks#30 for HK_STAGING_TEST_PR pr_number 52). Two things needed it at once: the frozen path requires a TEST_PR of the exact candidate, and this candidate's builder generation changed -- test-pr-v3 seals the image it builds into the fixed store, where test-pr-v2 reported an image id and then removed the image, leaving nothing deliverable.
release_candidate_reconciliation.new_evidence_note: new_evidence_blob_sha is audit information only. evidence_id is the evidence repository's record identity -- here the commit -- and has never been the blob id.

what_changed.executor_version: test-pr-v2 -> test-pr-v3: the artifact this candidate now names was built, tested and sealed by the durable-capable builder
what_changed.artifact_digest: a new immutable image, because a rebuild is not bit-reproducible
what_changed.artifact_durability: NOT_PROVEN -> PROVEN: the v3 build sealed the image into the fixed store, so the bytes exist and can be delivered
what_changed.gate_results: the v2 result carried 3 gates, the v3 result carries 4: B4-B1 added the artifact_sealed gate

what_did_not_change.builder_image: go-hotel:depth48-runtime-6d0fd905, pinned by tag and id

release_candidate_reconciliation.why_not_a_repeat_of_the_previous_case: The previous reconciliation moved only the artifact, between two builds of the same executor generation, and could say the executor version and the gate results were identical. This one cannot: the executor generation itself changed, and the artifact's durability changed with it. Both are recorded as written above rather than copied forward.
release_candidate_reconciliation.identity_rule_applied: artifact_digest, test_result_identity and artifact_package move together to the artifact the new signed result produced. The previous test result stays in the evidence repository as history; a stale artifact paired with a new test result is never kept.
